summary: Method: I pulled 32 frame strips from learn10x_V3.mp4. Ten were at 24 fps: S058 typing, S066 hand-off, S106 sit, S072 posts, and the S053 and S054 swaps (three strips). Eleven were cropped face strips at 8–12 fps: S064, S026, S083, S086 and S100 lip and face. The rest were 3–6 fps overviews of S066, S067, S072b, S091b, S093, S095, S090, S099, S102, S106, S108, S013, S020 and S037. I also recomputed the lip-sync envelope stats from vo_data.json with the new timeline.js smoothing, and read the V2→V3 engine diff. V3 fixed most of the mechanical problems I flagged in V2. The S058 strobe is gone (4.8 Hz arms, Eli seated). The S066 screwdriver stays in frame and tips onto a visible bench. Lip-sync amplitude is healthy now: 7.5% of dialogue frames at full open (was 32.5%) and 5.5% big jumps (was 20.4%), almost all of them on syllable attacks. Shout mouths now read as yelling. Numeric sit removed the hip pop. S072 finally reads as speed, and S093 reads as a swerve around the barrier. What keeps V3 at about 6 is acting, not mechanics. (1) A new finding: the generic talking mouth is an open-smile D shape whatever the expression, so sad lines are played with a grin: Noah's hurt 'can I at least do something?' (S064) and Eli's apology 'Thinking I didn't need you' (S100). (2) The S095 finish is out of sync: the robot's nose crosses the line about 1 s before the horn, then it stops dead. (3) Several beats still freeze or pop: S090 is a static point for 2.9 s, Noah stops mid-stride for 2 s in S102, there's a one-frame walk→stand pop in S106, the S053/S054 working poses snap and stay T-posed, and the S013 headstand hold. (4) The long dialogue two-shots have only lib-level sway (lean noise 1.6°): no gestures, nods or weight shifts.
strengths: S058 strobe fixed: arms at sin(t*30) (4.8 Hz). The 24 fps crop shows a smooth progression through the cycle, and the four ghosts now read as motion blur instead of a 2-state flicker. Eli is seated on a stool.

S066 works as a beat: the tool stays in Noah's hand until 2.7 s, then tips from 80° to flat onto a bench at y 880 that sits inside the frame at 1.08 zoom. The rotation settles, the push is sine, and still:true freezes the body for the silent hold (breathing and the 4 s blink remain).

Lip-sync amplitude: attack/release smoothing with a 1-frame lead brings the frames pinned at 1.0 down from 32.5% to 7.5% and the >.35 frame-to-frame jumps from 20.4% to 5.5% (89 of 90 are openings, which is correct). The S064 face crops show clear open/slit alternation at 12 fps.

Shout/panic mouth redesign (open arch, corners low, openness .35+.65*talk) plus angry brows: S083, S086 and S090 now read as yelling, not laughing. In S083 the mouth grows on 'NOAH!' and shrinks back to a small arch after the line.
Numeric sit in mixPose and drawFigure: at 24 fps the S106 hips descend onto the stool over 6–8 frames with no dip-and-hop.
S072: x −1200→3000 makes the fp 1.6 posts sweep about 70 px per frame. Speed reads now.
S093 re-staged as a close overhead: the robot pulls off barrier 1, arcs over its top end and turns to the right heading, with a blue trail and glow. The swerve reads as a swerve, not a wheelie.
S091b ignite: the LED ramps over 0.2 s from dark to blue-white with chassis spill, and the BACKUP · LEFT label fades in.
Idle sway (lean noise plus arm micro-noise unless o.still) gives long shots a little life, and the still:true override is used correctly in S066.
Blinks now cover expression switches: S026 at 1.55 s, S108 at 0.21 and 1.36 s, S100b at 0.86 s.
S102: Noah now steps in (walk phase), stops at x 1060 so the heads no longer interpenetrate, and Eli's rot recoil is visible.

v2_followup.v2_issue: S066 screwdriver vanishes under the letterbox, linear push
v2_followup.note: Verified at 20 fps (206.9–207.5 s): the tool stays in frame, tips 80°→0° and lies on the bench at screen y≈930. Polish left: the tool is tiny (scale .5, about 60 px) and the hand never lets go or withdraws (see issues).

v2_followup.v2_issue: S058 aliasing strobe, Eli standing, hands off laptop
v2_followup.note: Strobe gone (30 rad/s) and Eli is seated. Still to do: the hands type in the air below the laptop (laptop at 980,800, hands about 60 px lower and short of it), codeScreen((c.t*2)%1) blanks the screen every 0.5 s (reads as a flicker), and Noah's 'page turn' is still a 10° wobble.

v2_followup.v2_issue: ALL dialogue: mouth amplitude pinned and noisy; shout mouths never close
v2_followup.note: Amplitude is fixed (7.5% at 1.0, 5.5% jumps), and shout openness follows talk with a .35 floor. Not done: soft knee and 7 Hz modulation. The .62 release keeps the mouth half-open between syllables, so only 8.5% of dialogue frames are closed (<.08). New and more important: the talking mouth shape ignores expression (see issue 1).

About 1080 px/s with posts whipping past. Leftovers: the speed lines are fixed to the robot and don't flicker, the wheel spin (720°/s) is about half the ground speed, and S072 declares w twice (w:.6 is overridden by w:1).

Hip pop fixed. S106 still uses outBack on sitK (ey overshoots about 14 px into the stool), and the walk→stand switch at c.t=1.6 is a 1-frame pose pop: legs go from mid-stride to together and arms snap to [40,30] (24 fps crop at 336.42 s).

v2_followup.v2_issue: S053/S054 swaps pop, T-pose, objects float
v2_followup.note: No more empty frame (sIn starts at .6). The object still swaps in one frame after a 0.1 s shrink with no ghosts or whoosh. workPose changes in one frame at each swap (the arm angle and the circuit lean 12 pop). Arms stay out in a T, hands nowhere near the objects, and the chessboard stands upright like a sign.
Lib idle sway is in, but it's subtle (±1.6° lean). S090 is still a static P.point() from frame 1 to the end. S099/S100 have no gestures on stressed words and no listener nod.
The ball origin moved to (990,930), but the kick still peaks while the ball is at head height (frames 108.5–108.6 s). The phase was not realigned.

v2_followup.v2_issue: S102 bump skates and heads collide
v2_followup.note: Noah steps in and stops at 1060, the heads stay apart, and the recoil is visible. New problem: Noah freezes in a wide mid-stride for the remaining ~2 s. hit is still 25 px with no outBack recovery and no shared laugh bob.
The book moved to x 1090 and the face is visible. At this framing (h 360) the sitFacepalm rub still doesn't register as a hand to the face in the 3 fps overview.
Blinks now mask the switches in S026, S108 and S100b. No shared take() head pop on the S026/S108 shock onset, and S013 is unchanged.
P.sit front-on still puts both forearms out to the frame edges for the whole 3.1 s callback.

v2_followup.v2_issue: S093 swerve reads as a wheelie
v2_followup.note: Re-staged overhead and it reads. New minor problem: for the first ~0.3 s the robot body overlaps barrier 1 (see issues).

v2_followup.v2_issue: S036 no shin recoil, static facepalm
S038 cheer arm across face, whole goal shakes
S006 walkers too small to read

issues.shot: ALL dialogue (worst: S064, S100, also S088/S069/S071 when talking)
issues.problem: The generic talking mouth in rig.js face() is a flat-top, round-bottom D: Q(mx, my-.03R) on top, Q(mx, my+(.05+talk*.2)R) underneath. That is an open smile, and it replaces the expression mouth whenever talk>.08. Sad and worried characters therefore grin on every syllable and frown in the gaps. Noah's hurt 'Dude, can I at least do something?' (S064, face crops at 199.0–200.0 s) and Eli's apology 'Thinking I didn't need you' (S100, 313.6–314.4 s) both read as smiling. This undercuts the two most important emotional lines.
issues.fix: rig.js face(): make the talk mouth expression-aware. const o=talk; if (e==='sad'||e==='worried'||e==='unimpressed'||e==='bewildered') draw an inverted-D/trapezoid: M(mx-.8mw, my+.05R) Q(mx, my-(.03+.10*o)R) (mx+.8mw, my+.05R) Q(mx, my+(.07+.06*o)R) Z. That gives a high arched top, a flatter bottom and dropped corners. For 'neutral'/'busy'/'focused' use an oval: S.ellipse(mx, my+.02R, mw*(.55-.15*o), (.02+.12*o)*R). Keep the current D only for happy/smug/determined. Re-check S064, S100, S088 and S069 face crops.

issues.problem: The climax crossing is out of sync with the horn. k = E.out(t/1.2)*.9 puts the fastest motion first. The robot's nose (x+130·s = x+338) reaches the skewed line (x≈935 at the robot's ground) at t≈0.14 s, and the front wheel at t≈0.26 s. So the 'slow-mo creep over the line' is over almost a second before the horn and flash at 1.2 s. After the horn the robot eases .9→1 over 0.3 s and stops dead, with no follow-through.
issues.fix: act3.js S095: const xCross = 597 (nose on the line). x = c.t<1.2 ? lerp(380, xCross, E.inOut(seg(c.t,0,1.2))) : xCross + 520*E.out(seg(c.t,1.2,1.9)). The slow creep then ends exactly on the horn frame, and the release bursts through like slow-mo snapping back to speed. Add nose dip and settle after 1.9 s: rot = 3*Math.sin(Math.PI*seg(c.t,1.9,2.2)), wrapped in S.g rotate around the wheels. wheelRot = integral of speed (c.t<1.2 ? k*300 : 300 + (c.t-1.2)*1400). Optional: ghosts(dt => robot at x(t-dt), 3, .03, .3) only during 1.2–1.5 s.

issues.problem: 'Switch to the backup sensor! LEFT SIDE!' is still a static P.point() held from frame 1 for 2.9 s, with no hit and no emphasis on 'LEFT SIDE'. Noah is also small in frame (about a fifth of frame height), so only the mouth moves.
issues.fix: act3.js S090: pose: poseAt(c.t, [[0,{...P.shout(),lean:-6}],[.12,{...P.point(),lean:10},'outBack'],[1.6,{...P.point(),lean:10}],[1.75,{...P.point(),lean:14,fa:[95,0]},'outBack']]). The second hit lands on 'LEFT SIDE' (about L067 start+1.6). Add a 10-frame vibration lean += 1.5*Math.sin(c.t*2π*18)*clamp(1-(c.t-.12)/.4), shake 3 for 4 frames on each hit, and start the push tighter: CAM.push(1000,520,1.25,1.45,'out').

issues.problem: After the step-in Noah's walk phase freezes, because walkPh(1160 - x) stops changing when x stops. He stands for the last ~2 s in a wide mid-stride (legs apart, 322.0–323.7 s). The bump is still 25 px with a sine and no recovery overshoot, and there's no shared laugh, so the reconciliation's last image is two still figures.
issues.fix: act3.js S102: plan the step so it lands with feet together. const ph = walkPh(1160-x, 580) and stepEnd = atE(c,.8,1.0). pose = mixPose(P.walk(ph), {...P.stand(), lean:-4*k}, stepEnd). Bump: hit = 45*poseAt(c.t,[[.75,{v:0}],[.85,{v:1},'out'],[1.2,{v:-.15},'inOut'],[1.4,{v:0}]]).v. Then for c.t>1.2 give both a laugh: bob = 4*Math.abs(Math.sin(c.t*2π*2.5)), headTilt -10 (Eli) / +8 (Noah), expr 'happy', plus a 6-frame shoulder rise.

issues.problem: The hip pop is gone, but the walk→sit hand-off is still mechanical. At c.t=1.6 the pose jumps in one frame from P.walk mid-stride to P.stand with fa [40,30] (legs snap together, arms snap forward; 24 fps crop at 336.42 s). x stops with no deceleration step (wk is linear), and sitK uses outBack, so ey overshoots about 14 px below the seat before settling.
issues.fix: act3.js S106: wk = E.out(at(c,.3,1.6)) so he decelerates. Over the last 0.25 s blend the walk to stand: pose = mixPose(P.walk(walkPh(1560-ex,360)), P.stand(), atE(c,1.35,1.6)). Then sitK = atE(c,1.6,2.2,'inOut') and add a settle: ey += 6*Math.sin(Math.PI*seg(c.t,2.2,2.35)). Put a 3-frame anticipation (lean +8, drop 6) right before 1.6 so he 'looks' at the stool before sitting.

issues.problem: The swaps have no empty frame now, but they're still mechanical. Each object shrinks for 0.1 s and the next one appears at 60% scale in the next frame, with no ghosts or whoosh. workPose switches in one frame (the circuit lean 12 and the arm angles pop at 163.47 s). Eli stays in a T-pose with hands far from every object, the chessboard stands upright like a sign, and each object floats in front of his hips. It reads as props pasted over a static figure, not as obsession.
issues.fix: act2.js obsession(): blend poses with poseAt over the idx boundary: pose = mixPose(workPose[idx-1], workPose[idx], E.out(clamp(f/.2))). Rewrite the work poses front-on with elbows in and hands meeting at the object: cube {fa:[150+10*sin(2π·4t),40], ba:[150-10*sin(2π·4t),40]}, chess {fa:[130,25], ba:[20,10], headTilt:-6}, book {fa:[140,40], ba:[140,40]} with the book at y 1060 so the face stays clear, circuit {lean:8, headDrop:10, fa:[150,30], ba:[150,30]}. Lay the chessboard flat (scaleY .35, skewX -10) on a desk top at y≈1000 drawn in front of the legs. In the last 15% of each segment add ghosts(dt=>outgoing obj offset -900*dt px, 3, .03, .3) plus a white arc path.

issues.problem: The emotional two-shots run on lib sway only (±1.6° lean noise, arm noise ±3–4°). Eli says 'I'm so sorry' and 'Thinking I didn't need you' with arms hanging, and Noah listens in a frozen crossArms. There's no gesture, nod, shuffle or look-down/look-up, so the scene reads as two cut-outs exchanging audio.
issues.fix: act3.js S099: Eli poseAt keys for an apology gesture: at L071 start+.3 blend to {...P.stand(), fa:[40,95], ba:[20,40], lean:4} over 8 frames (open palm), back to stand by +1.4. lookY .4 (eyes down) on 'Dude...' and lookY 0 on 'sorry'. Noah: on L072 'For what?' give headTilt +6 and a 0.4 s nod (nod 0→5→0), and uncross the arms halfway (mixPose(P.crossArms(), P.stand(), .3)). S100: Eli's weight shift x += 8*E.inOut(seg) at mid-line, plus a hand to the back of the neck {fa:[160,150]} on 'didn't need you'.

issues.problem: The fall still ends in a headstand: head on the ground, torso vertical, legs in the air, held completely still from 36.6 to 38.2 s apart from one blink. The gag reads as a weird pose rather than a pratfall.
issues.fix: act1.js S013: end rot at -90 with the torso horizontal at ground y (hips at y_ground-12). Keys: [.6, rot -40], [.72, rot -95, 'in'], [.8, rot -86, 'outBack'] with an 8 px body bounce and shake 8 for 4 frames. Then +0.6 s: a leg twitch (fl hip +20→0 over 6 frames) and a dazed blink pair.

issues.problem: The tool lands, but the acting stops there. Noah's hand stays resting beside the screwdriver for the whole 2.5 s hold, so 'he leaves it behind' is never shown. The screwdriver is drawn at scale .5 (about 60 px long), small for the film's key prop in a 1.08 MCU.
issues.fix: act3.js S066: PR.screwdriver scale .5 → .9. After the settle, withdraw the hand: k2 = atE(c,3.4,4.2,'inOut') and pose = mixPose(P.placeTool(1), P.stand(), k2) (still:true stays, so only this key moves). The tool stays on the bench, alone in the gap. Add a headDrop of 6 px and the existing 4 s blink after the hand leaves.

issues.problem: Two flashes in 0.3 s: tin:'flash' whites out frames 0–1, frame 2 is dark, then the ignite flash whites out frame 3. The ignite therefore arrives as a strobe, not a reveal. After 0.4 s the LED is a perfectly static glow, with no sputter, pulse or camera reaction.
issues.fix: act3.js S091b: drop tin:'flash' (hard cut in on the dark chassis). Make the ignite sputter: on = c.t>.2 && !(c.t>.26 && c.t<.31). k = on ? E.out(clamp((c.t-.31)/.15)) : (c.t>.2 ? .5 : 0). Keep the single flashColor flash at .31. Then pulse glow op *= 1+.08*Math.sin(c.t*2π*3), and give the camera a punch: z = 1.1 + .05*c.p + .04*Math.sin(Math.PI*seg(c.t,.31,.45)).

issues.problem: For the first ~0.3 s the robot body is drawn on top of barrier 1 (the route starts at [1060,660] inside the bar's footprint), and with inOut it barely moves. It reads as the robot embedded in the metal, then sliding out, with no back-up, steering anticipation or wheel scrub.
issues.fix: act3.js S093: prepend a reverse segment: route = [[1080,690],[1060,660],...ROUTE_RECOVER.slice(1,4)] with k mapped so the first 15% is the back-up (heading held, x/y going back). Draw the robot under the barrier until it clears (z-order: robot before courseTop's bars while k<.15), and add two tire-scrub marks (dark arcs, opacity .3) at the pivot.

issues.problem: The strobe is fixed, but Eli types in the air: his hands sit below and short of the laptop on the bench. codeScreen((c.t*2)%1) resets every 0.5 s, so the screen blanks repeatedly (visible in the 24 fps crop). Noah's 'slow page turn' is still a 10° arm wobble, so the pace contrast is half there.
issues.fix: act3.js S058: move the laptop to Eli's hand height (PR.laptop(900, 860, .6)) or raise fa/ba so the hands land on the keys (fa [70±18, 50]). Use codeScreen(Math.min(1, c.t/c.d*1.2)) so code accumulates instead of resetting. Noah: page turn every 1.2 s as a rotating page rect from the held book (rotateY fake: scaleX cos(π·nk)) with ba 20°→110° outBack.

issues.problem: Still no contact. The kick pose peaks while the ball is near head height, and the ball drops back past a standing leg (108.4–108.6 s).
issues.fix: act2.js S037: make ph=0 the contact frame. repPose keys [[0,P.kick()],[.15,P.stand(),'out'],[.8,P.kickWind(),'inOut'],[1,P.kick(),'out']] with the ball's ground point at the kick foot (expose footF from character()). Squash the ball to scaleY .8 for 2 frames at ph<.06.

issues.problem: The callback CU still uses P.sit front-on, so both forearms stick out to the frame edges (starfish/meditation) for 3.1 s. This also breaks the 'same framing as S026' match, where Eli is standing with arms down.
issues.fix: act3.js S108: pose {...P.sitPiano(c.T,0), fa:[20,30], ba:[20,30]} (hands low and forward, out of frame), and add PR.keysTop at the bottom edge as in S107.

issues.problem: The .62 release keeps the mouth half-open between syllables: only 8.5% of dialogue frames are under .08, and L064 hovers at .5–.8 for most of the line. Plosives and pauses inside a line barely close. Separately, the shout mouth peaks around .27R tall, small for 'NOAH!' at CU scale compared with the reference's wide-open yells.
issues.fix: timeline.js speakAmp: release .62 → .45, then expand: a = clamp((s - .15)/.85). Apply the soft knee o = 1-(1-a)^2*.85, and on runs with a>.9 for 4+ frames multiply by 1-.15*(.5+.5*Math.sin(t*2π*7)). rig.js face() shout: widen to mw*1.0 and use height (.08+.30*op)*R.

issues.problem: Noah's exit is an opacity fade (2.7–3.0 s) in front of the open door instead of a walk through it, so he ghosts out rather than leaving. It softens the hardest exit in the film.
issues.fix: act3.js S067: drop the opacity. Draw a door-jamb mask (S.rect at the door's right edge, same colour as the wall, in front of Noah) and keep walking him to x 1700 so the jamb occludes him. Close the door 0.3 s after he's hidden (door already eases from 3.3 s).

issues.problem: Unchanged from V2: no shin recoil or flinch on the trap and a 2.6 s static facepalm (S036). The cheer arm sweeps across the face and the whole goal shakes (S038).
issues.fix: act2.js S036: 4-frame fl hip -20° recoil plus headDrop 6 at k=.95, and one head shake at 2.2 s. S038: intermediate key [1.0,{...P.kick(),fa:[90,20]}], and bulge only the back-net path.

issues.problem: Speed reads now, but the robot itself is rigid. The wheel spin (720°/s) is about half what 1080 px/s needs for r≈48 px wheels, the speed lines are glued to the chassis and never flicker, and there's no chassis bounce. The beat also declares w twice (w:.6 is overridden by the later w:1), so the planned shortening didn't happen.
issues.fix: act3.js S072: delete the second w:1. wheelRot = (x - (-1200))/(2π·48)*360. Chassis bounce: y = 820 + 3*Math.sin(c.t*2π*9). Speed lines: length 200+200*hash(i+Math.floor(c.t*12)), opacity .3+.4*hash(i*3+Math.floor(c.t*12)), regenerated every 2 frames.
